translations.idiomatic: On renshen Yuwen Qiong, deputy Wuping governor and Tanzhou administrator, was made Wuqing military governor while retaining Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，淮南招討使李重進奏，破淮賊於盛唐，斬二千級。

translations.literal: On day guiyou the Huainan pacification commissioner Li Chongjin memorialized defeating Huainan rebels at Shengtang, beheading two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Li Chongjin reported defeating Huainan rebels at Shengtang with two thousand heads taken.

sentences.zh: 太子賓客致仕薛仁謙卒。

translations.literal: The retired Guest of the Heir Apparent Xue Renqian died.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Renqian, retired guest of the heir apparent, died.

sentences.zh: 丙子，襄州節度使、守太尉、兼中書令、陳王安審琦加守太師。

translations.literal: On day bingzi the military governor of Xiangzhou, Acting Grand Guardian, Concurrent Director of the Secretariat, and Prince of Chen Wang Shenqi was promoted to Acting Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Wang Shenqi, Prince of Chen, Xiangzhou military governor, acting grand guardian, and concurrent director of the Secretariat, was promoted to acting grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 審琦鎮漢上十餘年，至是來朝，故以命寵之。

translations.literal: Shenqi had governed the Han River region for more than ten years; at this time he came to court, and therefore was honored with this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Shenqi had governed the Han River region for over ten years and came to court on this occasion, hence the honor.

sentences.zh: 癸未，右拾遺趙守微杖一百，配沙門島。

translations.literal: On day guiwei the Right Reminder Zhao Shouwei was beaten one hundred strokes and exiled to Shamen Island.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Right Reminder Zhao Shouwei was flogged one hundred strokes and exiled to Shamen Island.

sentences.zh: 守微本村民也，形貌樸野，粗學為文。

translations.literal: Shouwei was originally a village man, plain and rustic in appearance, with rough learning in writing.
translations.idiomatic: Shouwei was a villager of plain appearance who had learned writing only crudely.

sentences.zh: 前年徒步上書，帝以急於取士，授右拾遺，聞者駭其事。

translations.literal: The year before he went on foot to submit a memorial; the Emperor, eager to recruit talent, appointed him Right Reminder; hearers were shocked at the affair.
translations.idiomatic: The previous year he had walked to court with a memorial; the emperor, eager for talent, made him Right Reminder, to general astonishment.

sentences.zh: 至是為妻父所訟，彰其醜行，故逐之。

translations.literal: At this time he was sued by his wife's father, exposing his shameful conduct, and therefore was expelled.
translations.idiomatic: Now his father-in-law sued him, exposing scandalous conduct, and he was banished.

sentences.zh: （《東都事略·張昭傳》云：世宗好拔奇取俊，有自布衣上書、下僚言事者，多不次進用。

translations.literal: (Eastern Capital Epitome, biography of Zhang Zhao: Shizong liked to raise the extraordinary and select the outstanding; those who submitted memorials from commoner status or lower officials who spoke on affairs were often promoted out of turn.
translations.idiomatic: (Eastern Capital Epitome, biography of Zhang Zhao: Shizong loved promoting unusual talent; commoners and junior officials who submitted memorials were often advanced out of turn.

sentences.zh: 昭諫曰：「昔唐初劉洎、馬周起徒步，太宗擢用為相，其後朱樸、柳璨在下僚，昭宗亦以大用，然則太宗用之於前而國興，昭宗用於後而國亡，士之難知也如此。

translations.literal: Zhao remonstrated: "In early Tang Liu Ji and Ma Zhou rose from foot travelers; Taizong elevated them to chancellor; later Zhu Pu and Liu Can were lower officials whom Zhaozong also greatly used—yet Taizong used men in the former case and the state flourished, Zhaozong used men in the latter case and the state perished; how hard it is to know gentlemen is thus."
translations.idiomatic: Zhao remonstrated: "In early Tang Liu Ji and Ma Zhou rose from obscurity and Taizong made them chancellors; later Zhu Pu and Liu Can were promoted by Zhaozong—and the former brought prosperity, the latter ruin. Talent is hard to judge."

sentences.zh: 臣願陛下存舊法而用人，以劉、馬為鑒，朱、柳為戒，則善矣。」）〉

translations.literal: Your servant wishes Your Majesty to keep the old methods in employing men, take Liu and Ma as mirrors and Zhu and Liu as warnings—then it would be good.")〉
translations.idiomatic: I urge Your Majesty to follow established methods, taking Liu and Ma as models and Zhu and Liu as warnings.")〉

sentences.zh: 甲申，宣授今上同州節度使兼殿前都指揮使，宣授內外馬步軍都軍頭袁彥為曹州節度使兼侍衛步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: On day jiashen the heir apparent was announced appointed military governor of Tongzhou and concurrent Commander of the Palace Front; Yuan Yan, overall commander of internal and external horse and foot armies, was announced appointed military governor of Caozhou and concurrent Commander of the Imperial Foot Soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the heir apparent was announced as Tongzhou military governor and palace front commander; Yuan Yan, overall army commander, as Caozhou military governor and imperial foot commander.

sentences.zh: 戊子，右神武統軍張彥超卒。

translations.literal: On day wuzi the Commander of the Right Divine Martial Army Zhang Yanchao died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Zhang Yanchao, commander of the Right Divine Martial Army, died.

sentences.zh: 十一月己丑朔，詔廢天下無名祠廟。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the first day jichou, an edict abolished unlicensed shrines throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the eleventh month, the court abolished unauthorized shrines empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 庚子，日南至，帝不受朝賀，以宣懿皇后遷祔日近也。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the winter solstice, the Emperor did not accept court congratulations because the day for transferring the Xuanyi Empress's spirit tablet was near.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the winter solstice, the emperor declined court congratulations as the date for installing Empress Xuanyi's tablet approached.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，江南進奉使孫晟下獄死，江南進奉使鐘謨責授耀州司馬。

translations.literal: On day yisi the Jiangnan tribute envoy Sun Sheng died in prison; the Jiangnan tribute envoy Zhong Mo was demoted and appointed military adjutant of Yaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Jiangnan envoy Sun Sheng died in prison; fellow envoy Zhong Mo was demoted to military adjutant of Yaozhou.

sentences.zh: 戊申，放華山隱者陳摶歸山。

translations.literal: On day wushen the Huashan recluse Chen Tuan was released to return to the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Chen Tuan, recluse of Mount Hua, was released to return to his mountain retreat.

sentences.zh: 帝素聞摶有道術，征之赴闕，月餘放還舊隱。

translations.literal: The Emperor had long heard that Tuan possessed the Way and arts; he was summoned to court; after more than a month he was released to his former seclusion.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had long heard of Chen Tuan's mastery of the Way, summoned him to court, and after a month sent him back to seclusion.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，殿前都指揮使張永德奏，敗濠州送糧軍二千人於下蔡，奪米船十餘艘。

translations.literal: On day gengxu the Commander of the Palace Front Zhang Yongde memorialized defeating two thousand grain-transport troops from Haozhou at Xiaocai and seizing more than ten rice boats.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Zhang Yongde reported defeating two thousand Haozhou grain convoy troops at Xiaocai and seizing over ten rice boats.

sentences.zh: 宰臣李穀以風痹請告十旬，三上表求解所任，不允。

translations.literal: The chief minister Li Gu requested leave for ten ten-day periods because of wind paralysis; three times he submitted memorials asking to be relieved of his post; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Minister Li Gu took ten periods' leave for rheumatism and three times asked to resign; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未朔，以給事中張鑄為光祿卿，鑄訴以官名與祖諱同，尋改秘書監，判光祿寺事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the first day jiwei, the Supervising Secretary Zhang Zhu was made Director of the Imperial Household; Zhu pleaded that the office title matched his ancestor's taboo name; soon he was changed to Director of the Secretariat and assigned to administer the Imperial Household directorate.
translations.idiomatic: On the twelfth-month new moon, Supervising Secretary Zhang Zhu was made director of the Imperial Household but pleaded that the title matched his ancestor's taboo; he was soon made director of the Secretariat while administering the Imperial Household.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以許州節度使韓通兼侍衛馬步軍都虞候。

translations.literal: On day xinyou the military governor of Xuzhou Han Tong was made concurrent overall adjutant of the imperial horse and foot guards.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Xuzhou governor Han Tong was also made overall adjutant of the imperial horse and foot guards.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以右領軍大將軍、權判三司張美領三司使。

translations.literal: On day renxu the Right General of the Leading Army and acting administrator of the Three Departments Zhang Mei was put in charge as commissioner of the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Zhang Mei, right general of the leading army and acting Three Departments administrator, was made Three Departments commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以滑州節度使兼殿前都指揮使、駙馬都尉張永德為殿前都點校。

translations.literal: On day renshen the military governor of Huazhou, concurrent Commander of the Palace Front, and Commanderant of the Horse Zhang Yongde was made overall inspector of the palace front.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Zhang Yongde, Huazhou governor, palace front commander, and imperial son-in-law, was made overall inspector of the palace front.

sentences.zh: 發陳、蔡、宋、亳、潁、曹、單等州丁夫城下蔡。

translations.literal: Corvée laborers from Chen, Cai, Song, Bo, Ying, Cao, Shan, and other prefectures were mobilized to fortify Xiaocai.
translations.idiomatic: Laborers from Chen, Cai, Song, Bo, Ying, Cao, Shan, and other prefectures were drafted to fortify Xiaocai.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，故襄邑令劉居方贈右補闕，男士衡賜學究出身，獎廉吏也。

translations.literal: On day xinsi the former magistrate of Xiangyi Liu Jufang was posthumously given Right Supplementation Censor; his son Shiheng was granted the status of classical scholar by imperial favor, rewarding an incorrupt official.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the late magistrate of Xiangyi Liu Jufang was posthumously made Right Supplementation Censor and his son Shiheng granted scholar status, rewarding an honest official.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔兵部尚書張昭纂修太祖實錄及梁均王、唐清泰帝兩朝實錄。

translations.literal: On day guihai an edict ordered Minister of War Zhang Zhao to compile the Veritable Records of the Founding Emperor and the veritable records of the two reigns of Liang's Prince of Jun and Tang's Emperor Qingtai.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Minister of War Zhang Zhao was ordered to compile the Founding Emperor's Veritable Records and those of Liang's Prince of Jun and Tang's Emperor Qingtai.

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》云：同修撰官委張昭定名奏請，至四年正月，張昭奏請國子祭酒尹拙、太子詹事劉溫叟同編修。）〉

translations.literal: (Institutional History of the Five Dynasties: Co-compilers were entrusted to Zhang Zhao to fix names and memorialize; by the first month of the fourth year Zhang Zhao memorialized requesting the Director of the Imperial University Yin Zhuo and the Steward of the Heir Apparent Liu Wensou as co-editors.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Institutional History of the Five Dynasties: Zhang Zhao was to name co-compilers; in the first month of the fourth year he proposed Imperial University director Yin Zhuo and heir apparent steward Liu Wensou.)〉

sentences.zh: 又詔曰：「史館所少書籍，宜令本館諸處求訪補填。

translations.literal: Another edict said: "Books lacking in the History Institute should be sought and supplemented from all places by the institute."
translations.idiomatic: Another edict ordered the History Institute to seek out missing books everywhere.

sentences.zh: 如有收得書籍之家，並許進書人據部帙多少等第，各與恩澤，如是卷帙少者，量給資帛。

translations.literal: If there are households that have collected books, all are permitted to present books; according to the number of fascicles, each rank receives favor; if the volumes are few, compensation in goods and silks is given as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Households holding books might present them and receive rewards graded by the number of volumes; smaller collections would receive cloth and silk in proportion.

sentences.zh: 如館內已有之書，不在進納之限。

translations.literal: Books already in the institute are not within the limit for presentation.
translations.idiomatic: Books already held by the institute were not eligible for presentation rewards.

sentences.zh: 仍委中書門下，於朝官內選差三十人，據見在書籍，各求真本校勘，署校官姓名，逐月具功課申報中書門下。

translations.literal: Still the Secretariat was entrusted to select thirty men from court officials; according to existing books, each was to collate against true texts, sign the collator's name, and each month report achievement to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat was to select thirty court officials to collate existing holdings against authoritative texts, sign their work, and report monthly progress.

translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Li Chongjin reported defeating two thousand Huainan rebels north of Tashan.
